title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Sales Development agent for autonomous lead outreach
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, preview activation controls and Copilot Credit billing are supported. It appropriately reports conflicting Microsoft preview documentation rather than presenting one account as final. The outreach scheduling control discussed in the checklist is missing from the controls table.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an autonomous agent that researches, qualifies and engages leads around the clock.
claims.quote: Autonomous agent that researches, qualifies, engages with leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.
